_comment: Moonshot leg: $100 paper account, the most aggressive rules the data supports. Fully invested in whichever of BTC, ETH, SOL has the stronger trend while BTC is above its 100-day average, otherwise T-bills. No leverage (max_leverage 1.0); the aggression is the asset class, whose volatility is 2-3x equities. Costs modeled at 0.4% per side. See README: $100 reached $500 in 7 months from Sep 2020 and in 2.7 years from Apr 2018, and has not reached it in 4.8 years from the Jan 2022 start, with a -59% worst drawdown.
